Class MapParser<K,V>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.types.parser.AllocParser<Map<K,V>>
com.saicone.types.parser.MapParser<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - the type of keys in the map.
V - the type of values in the map.
All Implemented Interfaces:
TypeParser<Map<K,V>>, Function<Object,Map<K,V>>
public class MapParser<K,V> extends AllocParser<Map<K,V>>
Represents a parser that convert objects into a map.
